name: Pizzeria Al Caminetto
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Al Caminetto in Tirol**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Al Caminetto** in the heart of **Tirol**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the Alps. Our cozy wood-fired oven brings you the finest **Pizza Napoletana**, crafted with love and fresh, local ingredients.

Indulge in our signature dishes like the **Diavola**—spicy salami and chili peppers—or the **Margherita Classica**, topped with ripe tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and aromatic basil. For those craving something heartier, try our **Calzone** stuffed with ricotta, spinach, and mushrooms.

Pair your meal with a glass of crisp **Lagrein** or a refreshing **Radler**—the perfect blend of beer and lemon soda. Whether you're visiting **Innsbruck**, exploring the **Zillertal**, or taking a scenic drive through the **Ötztal**, **Pizzeria Al Caminetto** is your go-to spot for a taste of Italy in the mountains.

After dinner, warm up with a slice of **Kaiserschmarrn** or a creamy **Apfelstrudel**—sweet treats to end your evening on a high note.

Come for the pizza, stay for the atmosphere. **Benvenuti a Tirol!**
